rca_of_issue:
BUG (NEW, MEDIUM): demo-startfree-button perceived ~10s freeze.
Reproduction: 1) Register fresh user -> /demo. 2) Tap any suggestion chip; wait for guide. 3) Tap 'Start building with my free credits'. 4) Observe URL stays at /demo for ~10 seconds, then jumps to /(tabs).
Root cause: /app/frontend/app/demo.tsx:241 onPress handler is `async () => { try { await updateProfile({onboarded:true}); } catch {} router.replace('/(tabs)'); }`. Immediately after guide generation, demo.tsx (line 88) fires `api(/projects/{id}/step/{id}/image, POST)` as a non-awaited background promise — this OpenAI gpt-image-1 call takes 10-15s. The browser's fetch queue (HTTP/1.1 keep-alive or backend worker) appears to serialize the subsequent PUT /api/profile behind that in-flight image POST, so the `await updateProfile` blocks the entire 10-15s. router.replace doesn't fire until then, with NO visual feedback on the button.
Mitigation: Either (a) navigate first then update profile: `router.replace('/(tabs)'); updateProfile({onboarded:true}).catch(()=>{});` — clean & instant. Or (b) add setBusy state + ActivityIndicator on the button. Recommended: (a).
